1.explanation:
We programmatically reproduce the exact user steps: load a BPMN with a Participant containing labeled events, copy its child shapes, delete them, then paste into the root process. The bpmn-js copyPaste module handles labels specially, causing text labels (BPMNLabel shapes) not to be restored. When you run this code in a browser environment with a
, you will see the bug: the start/end events reappear without their labels.
1.bug_scenario: In the example diagram you have a single BPMN pool (Participant) containing a start event (circle) labeled “A”, a task in the middle, and an end event labeled “B”.  When you select all of the shapes inside the pool (i.e. start event, task, end event and their connecting sequence flows), then remove the original, and finally paste the copied shapes into a blank diagram, the two event labels (“A” and “B”) do not get pasted along with their events. The events themselves appear, but their text labels are missing.
